verdict.rationale: llms.txt returns a 404 (xero-probe-1), so there is no dedicated agent-oriented manifest file, but Xero does provide an official MCP server and AI toolkit documentation (developer.xero.com/documentation/tools/mcp-server, xero-docs-6, xero-docs-19) that an agent could be pointed at instead. This partially satisfies the intent of agent-discoverable docs but not via the standard llms.txt convention. missing for 10: a working llms.txt endpoint, evidence of agent-oriented markdown docs beyond MCP server README, independent confirmation an agent successfully consumes these docs.
